title: Floating Machi Koro-style central illustration spec: Garazhnyy kooperativ
purpose: Generate only a transparent central illustration for compositing onto the blank blue card template.

integration_context.target_use: An isolated floating miniature scene for the middle of a Machi Koro-style establishment card.
integration_context.background_requirement: Native RGBA transparency. Every pixel outside the miniature base, subjects, props, and soft barbecue smoke must have zero alpha. No environment, sky, card frame, header, footer, coin, icon, or text.
integration_context.central_positioning: Centered, self-contained, landscape-oriented cluster with generous transparent margins. Nothing clipped.

style_goal.core_formula: Cute simplified tabletop-game miniature scene plus cozy recognizable post-Soviet garage-cooperative life.
style_goal.rendering: Original Machi Koro illustration language: chunky clean shapes, loose playful three-quarter perspective, sparse outlines, low-to-moderate detail, one or two-tone graphic shading, never photorealistic.
style_goal.orientation: The row of garages faces slightly to the right, showing fronts and right sides in readable three-quarter view. Generate this orientation directly.

visual_composition.shape: A compact horizontal floating diorama on one small irregular paved-and-grassy courtyard base.
visual_composition.main_subject: A row of four modest Soviet metal garage boxes with mismatched muted doors. One garage is open and a classic boxy Soviet sedan is parked in front with its hood raised.
visual_composition.people_and_props: Three adult men stand casually together holding plain unlabeled beer bottles or mugs near a tiny charcoal brazier with skewers and a delicate curl of smoke.
visual_composition.lighting: Warm friendly sunshine from a small stylized sun glow implied only by highlights; do not draw sky or a detached sun disk. Cozy weekend mood.
visual_composition.scale_priority: Garages and open-hood car must read first; men and brazier remain simple but clearly recognizable at card size.

recognition_details: utilitarian concrete and corrugated-metal Soviet garage row with patched muted blue-gray, olive, beige, and rust-red doors
one classic boxy Soviet passenger car in three-quarter side profile, hood visibly propped open, blank featureless license-plate area with absolutely no characters
three simplified men socializing with beer beside a small mangal, warm sunlight and a modest patch of grass creating a cozy lived-in atmosphere
miniature_base: A small self-contained cracked-paving slab with two restrained tufts of grass; no surrounding landscape.

palette.saturation: low to moderate, clean and readable

simplify: garage doors as broad geometric panels with only a few seams and hinges
car as a chunky iconic boxy silhouette with minimal trim
people as friendly toy-like figures with simple poses and no facial detail
mangal as one small dark rectangular brazier with a few bold skewers
omit: all letters, numbers, logos, signs, plaques, graffiti, labels, license-plate characters, bottle labels, pseudo-writing, and text-like marks
blank signboards, menu boards, posters, banners, and surfaces that invite generated writing
photorealism, cinematic effects, gritty texture, dense grime, complex tools, clutter, weapons, intoxication caricature, full landscape, and full-card composition
target_impression: A warm, humorous, instantly recognizable Russian garage cooperative rendered as a charming Machi Koro board-game miniature.
final_prompt_summary: Generate only this compact floating garage-cooperative miniature on a genuinely transparent background. Show the garages in front-and-right three-quarter view, the boxy Soviet car with its hood open, three men holding beer, and a tiny mangal. Preserve the cozy sunlit mood through warm highlights without depicting sky or a separate background sun. Output a clean RGBA PNG with generous transparent margins and no clipping. Absolutely no text or text-like marks anywhere, including signs, garage doors, bottles, clothing, and license plates. No card furniture and no full scene background.
